gameplay.sourcePreservation: Star-ring observations retain deterministic-projection; no projection is counted as a committed write.

restorePolicy.supportedOverride: build-skill-vfx-coverage.mjs accepts repeatable --evidence=relative/file.json; the normalizer accepts repeatable --gameplay=path and --atlas=path plus --out=path.
restorePolicy.recommended: Archive these 10 evidence files byte-for-byte with a path map. In a fresh checkout restore each to its recorded .release-sync path before running coverage --check. Canonical receipts carry embedded source paths; simply pointing --evidence at renamed copies does not resolve those source dependencies.
restorePolicy.doNot: Do not rewrite embedded source paths or SHA values to make a report pass.
restorePolicy.byteExact: Restore the archived canonical receipts unchanged and run --check to reproduce this exact manifest SHA.
restorePolicy.renormalization: Re-running the browser normalizer writes a new generatedAt and therefore a new receipt SHA. Run the coverage builder again afterward; this is a fresh report, not a byte-identical reproduction.
